slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single copy, no backup or mirroring. Valid iff EEPROM read succeeds AND header byte 0 == 'N' (0x4E) AND CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE(header[0x00..0x37]) == u16 at header+0x38 AND sum of CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE over each of the 7 data chunks (60 bytes each) == u32 at header+0x34 (FUN_08008ec4). Otherwise the whole save is rejected and defaults are used. No generation/sequence counter.

checksums.name: header_crc16
checksums.formula_detail: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE: poly 0x1021, init 0xFFFF, MSB-first (crc = (crc<<8) ^ table[((crc>>8)^byte)]), no reflection, no final XOR; implemented by FUN_08041c38. Stored after aggregate at 0x34 is final and byte 0x32 has been zeroed by the saver.

checksums.name: chunk_crc16_sum
checksums.formula_detail: Sum (u32) of CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE (poly 0x1021, init 0xFFFF, MSB-first, no final XOR, FUN_08041c38) computed over each of the 7 data chunks' 60 data bytes (chunk offsets 0x40+0x40*i, i=0..6). No per-chunk CRC is stored; pad bytes at chunk+0x3C..0x3F are excluded. cap-01: 4*0xf132 + 3*0xddb6 = 0x00065dea.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 primitive: programs DMA source/dest/control (param3|0x80000000 enable) via 0x040000D4-family registers, waits on busy bit 0x8000; used to transfer bitstreams to/from EEPROM window 0x0D000000.

Read one 8-byte EEPROM block: sends 2 start bits + address bits (count from chip config byte +8) MSB-first via FUN_0804a7d0 to 0x0D000000, reads 0x44 halfwords back, extracts 64 bits into 4 u16 written backwards from dst+6 (origin of in-block byte reversal in raw .sav).

Write one 8-byte EEPROM block: expands 4 u16 into 64 bits MSB-first, prepends write opcode/address bits, DMAs addr_bits+0x43 halfwords to 0x0D000000, polls EEPROM busy (0x0D000000 & 1); uses helpers FUN_0804a704/FUN_0804a78c.
Verify: re-reads block via FUN_0804a850 and compares 4 u16; returns 0x8000 on mismatch.
Write-with-retry: up to 3 rounds of FUN_0804a900 + FUN_0804a9dc verify.
Byte-range EEPROM read wrapper (device type 3 only): block addr (offset & 0x7FFFF)>>3, 8 bytes per FUN_0804a850 call, handles trailing partial block.
Byte-range EEPROM write wrapper (device type 3 only): per-8-byte-block FUN_0804aa34; flags error state 7 on status bit 0x8000.

CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE (table-driven MSB-first; table/init ROM literals identified empirically as poly 0x1021 / init 0xFFFF by exact match on real saves). Callers per decompiled C text; callgraph.json records none (func_0x spelling omitted).
Load: reads header (0,0x3C) and 7 chunks (0x40+0x40*i, 0x40 read / 0x3C copied), checks magic 'N', header CRC at +0x38, and chunk CRC sum at +0x34; returns 1 on success.

Save: recomputes chunk CRC sum into header+0x34, zeroes header+0x32, stores header CRC at +0x38, writes 7 chunks (0x3C data + 4 zero pad) then header. No caller recorded in callgraph/decompiled text (unrecovered jumptable dispatch); caller unknown.

Factory-default init: writes header constants and 'N' magic, sets unlock bits 1/11/31 via FUN_0800988c, fills 7 chunks with 5x12-byte template entries chosen per block by FUN_08009900. No caller recorded; trigger inferred as load-failure/first-boot.
Save-device init called at boot as FUN_08041e44(3,4): selects EEPROM (type 3) chip configuration via FUN_0804a664/FUN_0804a6cc.

fields.name: magic_N
fields.update_mechanism: Written once by factory-default init; loader rejects save if != 'N'. Appears at raw file offset 7 due to per-8-byte-block reversal.
fields.evidence: FUN_08008da4 writes 0x4E; FUN_08008ec4 checks *hdr != 'N'; reversed cap-01 byte 0 = 0x4E.

fields.name: header_byte_01
fields.update_mechanism: Constant 3 from defaults init; covered by header CRC; semantics unknown.

fields.name: header_byte_02
fields.update_mechanism: Constant 3 from defaults init; semantics unknown.

fields.name: header_byte_03
fields.update_mechanism: Constant 1 from defaults init; semantics unknown.

fields.name: header_byte_04_transient_flag
fields.update_mechanism: Defaults init writes 0; saver clears it for the duration of the flush and restores it afterwards, so the persisted value is the in-RAM value at save time.
fields.evidence: FUN_08008f5c: saved to stack, *(hdr+4)=0 before writes, restored after header write.

fields.name: header_byte_05
fields.update_mechanism: Constant 0 from defaults init; semantics unknown.

fields.name: header_byte_06
fields.update_mechanism: Constant 1 from defaults init; semantics unknown.

fields.name: header_byte_07
fields.update_mechanism: Constant 3 from defaults init; semantics unknown.

fields.name: progress_bitfield
fields.update_mechanism: FUN_0800988c(bit<100): hdr[8+(bit>>3)] |= 1<<(bit&7). Defaults init zeroes 0x08..0x20 then sets bits 1, 11, 31; further gameplay setters untraced.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800988c body and FUN_08008da4 calls (1, 0xb, 0x1f) reproduce the observed bytes 02 08 00 80 exactly.

fields.name: header_bytes_15_20
fields.update_mechanism: Zeroed by defaults init (loop over +8 for 0x19 bytes, plus explicit +0x15=+0x16=0); semantics unknown; overlaps tail of the bitfield region.
fields.evidence: FUN_08008da4 zero loop and explicit writes.

fields.name: header_bytes_21_23_uninitialized
fields.update_mechanism: No writer traced; defaults init stops at 0x20. 0xFF suggests erased/uninitialized bytes copied verbatim, or a field set by untraced code.
fields.evidence: Observed ff ff ff; absent from FUN_08008da4 writes.

fields.name: header_u32_24
fields.update_mechanism: Zeroed by defaults init; semantics unknown.

fields.name: header_bytes_28_2f
fields.update_mechanism: Zeroed by defaults init (8-byte loop at +0x28); semantics unknown.
fields.evidence: FUN_08008da4 loop.

fields.name: header_byte_30
fields.update_mechanism: Constant 5 from defaults init; semantics unknown.

fields.name: header_byte_31_uninitialized
fields.update_mechanism: No writer traced (init writes +0x30, +0x32, +0x33 only in this area).
fields.evidence: Observed 0xff; absent from FUN_08008da4 writes.

fields.name: header_byte_32_flag
fields.update_mechanism: Defaults init sets 1; saver clears to 0 before computing the header CRC, so the on-disk value is always 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08008da4: *(hdr+0x32)=1; FUN_08008f5c: *(hdr+0x32)=0 before CRC16(header,0x38).

fields.name: header_byte_33_persisted_setting
fields.update_mechanism: Defaults init and boot-on-load-failure write 0; on load success boot copies it to game-state +0x85. Meaning unknown.
fields.evidence: FUN_08035420 boot body: failure branch *(hdr+0x33)=0, success branch game_state+0x85 = hdr+0x33.

fields.name: chunk_crc_sum
fields.update_mechanism: Recomputed on every save as the sum of the 7 chunk CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE values; verified against real saves (Section 4 of report).
fields.evidence: FUN_08008f5c accumulation loop; Python: 4*0xf132+3*0xddb6=0x65dea matches stored.

fields.name: header_crc16
fields.update_mechanism: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE over header bytes 0x00..0x37, stored LE (as u32 with zero high half, bytes 0x38..0x3B = e5 de 00 00) on every save.
fields.evidence: FUN_08041c38 + FUN_08008f5c/FUN_08008ec4; Python computed dee5 == stored dee5 on cap-01.

fields.name: header_pad
fields.update_mechanism: Saver zeroes stack bytes 60..63; loader reads 0x40 but copies only 0x3C. Block-alignment padding, not checksummed.
fields.evidence: FUN_08008f5c stack zeroing; FUN_08008ec4 memcpy length 0x3C.

fields.name: score_entry_name

observed_values.cap-01-future-1.sav: "SMB\0" at chunk+12*j (j=0..4) in all 7 chunks (file offsets 0x40+0x40*i+12*j)

fields.update_mechanism: Copied from one of 4 ROM templates (chosen per chunk by FUN_08009900) by defaults init; gameplay overwrite by score-insertion code untraced. Field offset shown is chunk 0 entry 0; repeats every 12 bytes within each 64-byte chunk.
fields.evidence: Reversed cap-01 chunks are exactly 5x ('SMB\0', score, 0); FUN_08008da4 copies 3-word records from ROM template pointers.

fields.name: score_entry_score
fields.update_mechanism: Template default score copied by defaults init; gameplay replacement untraced. Offset shown is chunk 0 entry 0 score; repeats every 12 bytes.
fields.evidence: Reversed cap-01: e8 03 00 00 (=1000) chunks 0-3, 32 00 00 00 (=50) chunks 4-6; FUN_08008da4 template copy.

fields.name: score_entry_word2
fields.update_mechanism: Third word of the 12-byte template record copied by defaults init; meaning unknown (no non-zero sample). Offset shown is chunk 0 entry 0; repeats every 12 bytes.
fields.evidence: FUN_08008da4 copies puVar3[0..2] per entry; observed third word always 0.

fields.name: chunk_pad
fields.update_mechanism: Saver zeroes stack bytes 60..63 per chunk; loader discards. Not checksummed. Offset shown is chunk 0 pad; repeats per chunk.
fields.evidence: FUN_08008f5c / FUN_08008ec4 lengths 0x40 written/read vs 0x3C copied/CRC'd.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Change magic 'N' (0x4E) to 'O' in RAM order (raw file offset 7), repair header CRC only
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Load rejected on magic check in FUN_08008ec4 despite valid CRC; defaults boot and header+0x33 force-cleared.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Flip one bit of stored header CRC, no repair
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Load rejected on header-CRC mismatch; defaults used.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Set chunk 0 entry 0 score 1000 -> 999999 (u32 LE), repair chunk CRC sum and header CRC
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Corresponding high-score table shows 999999 for name SMB at rank 1; no effect refutes score interpretation.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Set chunk 0 entry 0 name 'SMB\0' -> 'ZZZ\0', repair checksums
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Score table displays ZZZ; confirms plain ASCII name encoding.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Set chunk 4 entry 0 score 50 -> 51 (offset 0x140+4), repair checksums
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Only the chunks 4-6 table family changes; divergent UI effect vs chunk 0 identifies the mode/difficulty split.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Set bit 2 of progress bitfield (byte |= 0x04), repair header CRC; sweep bits 0..99 individually
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: An unlock/progress element becomes available per FUN_0800988c semantics; maps the bitfield.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Set header byte 0x33 0x00 -> 0x01, repair header CRC
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Boot copies byte to game-state +0x85; observe which title/menu setting changes. In a CRC-broken variant it should be force-cleared to 0.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Set uninitialized header bytes 0x21..0x23 (and separately 0x31) from 0xFF to 0x00, repair header CRC
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: No visible change supports uninitialized-padding classification; any change promotes them to real fields.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Set chunk 0 entry 0 third word 0 -> 1 (then larger), repair checksums
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Reveals third-word meaning (time/character/flags) via score-table row change, or confirms reserved padding.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Set chunk 0 pad bytes (chunk+0x3C) to 0xFF, no checksum repair (pad is outside coverage)
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Load still succeeds unchanged; failure would refute pad/coverage analysis.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Write random bytes at 0x200+, no repair
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Load still succeeds; region is never read. Failure would indicate a second save area missed statically.

open_questions: Concrete RAM addresses of the header struct and the 7 chunk structs: referenced only via unresolved literal pools (_DAT_08008f44, pointer tables _DAT_08008f48/_DAT_08009038); literal values are not in the workspace, so ram_addr is null rather than guessed.

Caller of the saver FUN_08008f5c and of the defaults initializer FUN_08008da4: neither has a recorded caller in callgraph.json nor a textual call site in decompiled.c (unrecovered jumptable/function-pointer dispatch).

Gameplay writers of score entries (name/score/third word beyond defaults) and of progress bits beyond the initial 1/11/31: FUN_0800988c and the chunk structs must be written during play, but no further call sites are recoverable from the extraction.
Semantics of header bytes 0x01..0x07, 0x15..0x30 constants, byte 0x33 (a persisted setting copied to game-state +0x85 at boot), and the score entries' third word (always 0 in samples).
Header bytes 0x21..0x23 and 0x31 hold 0xFF and are written by no traced function: uninitialized/erased bytes copied verbatim, or fields set by untraced code before the first save.

Which gameplay mode/difficulty each of the 7 chunks (and the 1000-default vs 50-default families) corresponds to; per-chunk category values returned by the FUN_08009900 ROM table are not in the workspace.

Exact chip-config values (block count at config+4, address-bit count at config+8) selected by FUN_08041e44(3,4)/FUN_0804a664/FUN_0804a6cc: behind literal pools; bounded by the observed use of EEPROM block addresses 0..63 only.
No paired .ss save states ship in this workspace (states/ is empty), so the fuzzing plan in the report must be executed from cold boot with the mutated .sav in place.
